name: ^setTimeout$
reason: The platform timer accepts the callback and delay; the twin checks the delay and when the timer is set.

name: ^resolve$
reason: The Promise resolver takes no value here; the twin decides when the sleep ends.

name: ^setInterval$
reason: The platform timer accepts the reaper and period; the twin checks both and that only the first worker starts it.

name: ^reaper\.unref$
reason: Node marks the timer as not keeping the process alive; the twin decides it runs once with the timer.

name: ^next$
reason: A queued waiter's resolver takes no value; the twin decides from the recorded queue whether one exists.

name: ^crypto\.subtle\.importKey$
reason: WebCrypto imports the checked raw bytes; the twin selects the algorithm and usages and never reads the key.

name: ^cache\.(get|set)$
reason: A WeakMap keyed by the key bytes; the twin decides from the answer whether to import and what to store.

name: CryptoKey
reason: A WebCrypto handle the twin only passes along, never reads.

name: WeakMap
reason: The key cache; lookups are answered through checked cache.get effects.

name: IsolateWorker
reason: A worker handle the twin returns unread; its own methods have their own twins.

name: Timeout
reason: A timer handle the twin only tests for presence.

name: Promise
reason: The not-yet-settled key the cache stores; the twin checks it is stored and reads the settled value from the import effect.

name: Readable
reason: A stream nested in a ChildProcess held by a worker handle; twins only pass the handle along and never read the stream.

name: WriteStream
reason: A stream nested in a ChildProcess held by a worker handle; twins only pass the handle along and never read the stream.

name: Object
reason: Node's internal stream state nested in a worker's ChildProcess; twins never read inside the handle.
